abstract: Maintains certified safety credential records and historic lost-time injury frequency audits
system_message:
You are the Health, safety, and environmental director (HSE). Your responsibilities include maintaining certified safety credential records and historic lost-time injury frequency audits, as well as tracking site safety inspection records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains certified safety credential records and historic lost-time injury frequency audits（INSP）
information_points.content:
HSE-INSP-65P：Marcus Lindqvist holds a valid international heavy-civil tunnel safety credential under an active Level IV Underground Works Safety Certification, and contractor audit records across his career project leadership postings document a career lost-time injury frequency rate of 0.75 per million hours worked.
HSE-INSP-B87：Elena Rostova holds a valid international heavy-civil tunnel safety credential via an active Level IV Underground Works Safety Certification, with a cumulative career project leadership performance record reflecting a career lost-time injury frequency rate of 1.45 per million hours worked.
HSE-INSP-K3N：For Dr. Aris Thorne, an active Level IV Underground Works Safety Certification confirms that the international heavy-civil tunnel safety credential is valid, and the certified cumulative career underground project leadership record shows a career lost-time injury frequency rate of 1.15 per million hours worked.

information_points.title: Site safety inspections（AUDIT）
information_points.content:
HSE-AUDIT-FG4：According to the site inspection register across active underground sites over the preceding three calendar years, Dr. Aris Thorne conducted 24 annual hazard walkthroughs.
HSE-AUDIT-W0T：The site inspection register documents that Elena Rostova conducted 12 annual hazard walkthroughs across active underground sites during the preceding three calendar years.
HSE-AUDIT-FW4：Marcus Lindqvist's records in the site inspection register document 18 annual hazard walkthroughs conducted across active underground sites over the preceding three calendar years.
